description: This file provides test utilities and helpers for widget testing in Flutter, including functions to initialize database connection via FFI, pump frames, wait for conditions, and clean up resources after tests.

methods.name: initSqfliteFfiForTests
methods.description: Initializes the sqflite package to use FFI implementation, ensuring it's done only once.

methods.name: pumpFrames
methods.description: Pumps a fixed number of frames in the widget tester to advance the UI deterministically.

methods.name: assertNoScheduledFramesAfterPumps
methods.description: Pumps a set number of frames and asserts that no frames are scheduled afterward.

methods.name: pumpAndSettleBounded
methods.description: Pumps frames until the framework is idle or a timeout occurs, with optional assertion.

methods.name: pumpUntilFound
methods.description: Pumps frames until a specific widget finder is found or a timeout occurs.

methods.name: pumpUntilNoScheduledFrames
methods.description: Continuously pumps frames until the framework is idle or timeout, with diagnostics.

methods.name: unmountWidgetTree
methods.description: Unmounts any current widget tree and runs bounded settle to clean up.

methods.name: disposeAppDependencies
methods.description: Cleans up resources such as download engines and database connections after tests.
